title: Bank Handling Charge for Large Returned Items on a Home Purchase Agreement
content:
**Escrow memo.** The bank's handling charge for a large returned item is passed through to the buyer on the Home Purchase Agreement returned-payment fee. The amount read is that of the latest returned payment on the agreement ledger, compared with the collection's wire threshold (the single-payment amount above which a deposit payment must be a wire):

- where the latest returned payment is **above** the collection's wire threshold, **40.00** is added;
- where it is above half of the wire threshold but **not above** the wire threshold, **15.00** is added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

## Thresholds by collection

| Collection | Wire threshold (USD) | Half of the wire threshold (USD) | 40.00 added when the latest returned payment is | 15.00 added when it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | 10000.00 | 5000.00 | above 10000.00 | above 5000.00 up to 10000.00 |
| Meadow Collection | 10000.00 | 5000.00 | above 10000.00 | above 5000.00 up to 10000.00 |
| Heritage Collection | 25000.00 | 12500.00 | above 25000.00 | above 12500.00 up to 25000.00 |
| Crestview Collection | 25000.00 | 12500.00 | above 25000.00 | above 12500.00 up to 25000.00 |
| Summit Collection | 50000.00 | 25000.00 | above 50000.00 | above 25000.00 up to 50000.00 |
| Reserve Collection | 50000.00 | 25000.00 | above 50000.00 | above 25000.00 up to 50000.00 |

## Both sides of each line (hypothetical Heritage Collection returns)

| Latest returned payment | Added |
|---|---|
| 25000.01 | 40.00 |
| 25000.00 | 15.00 (not above 25000.00) |
| 12500.01 | 15.00 |
| 12500.00 | Nothing (not above half of 25000.00) |
